Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-103.json runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1
Two candidates lead (P=1.238d and P=5.235d, both ~0.28 support); theta=0.997 is strict. Let me check diagnostics.

Support is split 0.281/0.285 between candidates 0 and 1, both far ahead of the rest but nowhere near theta. Slot 1 (t≈35.32) is cheap (only skips slot 0) and appears in the top discriminating slots for 9 of the weaker-candidate pairs — good value before committing deep for the 0-vs-1 fight.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1 --slot 1 --why "Slot 1 is cheap, only skipping slot 0, and separates most of the weaker-candidate pairs at once, letting us prune the field before spending budget on the leading pair"

input.description: Check current state and remaining slots

content.text: Pair (3,4) now dominates (support_product 0.164, next-best 0.044) — the real contest is 1.085d vs 0.929d. Slot 5 (t≈43.29) is the earliest slot hitting max separation for that pair, also helping resolve 0-3 secondarily.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1 --slot 5 --why "Candidates 3 and 4 now dominate support and slot 5 is the earliest reachable point giving max separation for that pair"

content.text: Candidate 3 leads (0.867) but hasn't crossed theta. The dominant remaining uncertainty is 2-vs-3 (support_product 0.063, highest), and its discrimination lives late (only 10 future slots exceed 2σ, best at slot 13) — a deep jump is justified here per protocol.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1 --slot 13 --why "Pair 2 versus 3 carries the largest remaining support product and its discrimination is concentrated late, with slot 13 the earliest point reaching max separation for that pair"

input.description: Check current state for remaining slots

content.text: Slot 19 (t≈68.14) is the earliest slot with near-max separation for the dominant pair (2 vs 3). I'll observe there, treating it as the confirming point after the sharp swing at slot 13.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1 --slot 19 --why "Support flipped sharply toward candidate 2 after slot 13, so this confirms the leading pair, 2 versus 3, at the earliest slot reaching comparable maximum separation"
input.description: Observe slot 19 to confirm leading pair

content.text: Candidate 2 crossed theta (support 0.9980 ≥ 0.997). Resolution achieved with budget to spare — finalize.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1 --why "Candidate 2, period near 13.2 days, crossed theta at support 0.998 after the confirming observation at slot 19, resolving the alias unambiguously"

content.text:
Campaign resolved: candidate 2 (P≈13.21 d) selected with support 0.998 ≥ θ=0.997, using 4 of 6 observations.

Summary of the trajectory:
- Initial fit favored candidates 0/1 (P≈1.24d, 5.24d) nearly tied at ~0.28 each.
- Slot 1 collapsed 0/1 and revealed 3/4 (P≈1.09d, 0.93d) as the real leaders (~0.40 each).
- Slot 5 pushed candidate 3 to 0.87, still short of θ.
- Slot 13 caused a sharp reversal, flipping the lead to candidate 2 (P≈13.2d) at 0.76 — a swing large enough to warrant confirmation per protocol.
- Slot 19 confirmed candidate 2 decisively at 0.998, crossing θ.

Run artifacts are in `runs/dev-v2-case-103-r1`.
